findings.title: Unrestricted Force Override in Metadata Restore
findings.resolution: Replaced generic force_rollback boolean with dual-mode architecture: SafeOnline (strictly rejects rollbacks) and IsolatedRebootstrap (requires explicit signed DisasterRebootstrapAuthorization, writes recovery_provenance.rec, and advances epoch by +100 to fence stale coordinators).

findings.title: Cryptographic Key Custody & Leaked Secret Risk in Backups
findings.resolution: Enforced that metadata backups only contain public keys. Implemented DisasterRecoveryBackupBundle::scan_for_plaintext_secrets to detect and reject private key headers/markers. Implemented KeyRecoveryPackage with AES-256-GCM envelope encryption, escrow signature verification, and revocation.

findings.title: Ambiguous Recovery Freshness Semantics
findings.resolution: Separated global consensus certainty from local checkpoints: AuthenticGlobalLatest now strictly requires a verified QuorumCertifiedCheckpoint with majority voter signatures. Otherwise classifies as AuthenticLocallyCurrent, AuthenticHistoricalVersion, or UnverifiableFreshness.

findings.title: Unsafe Garbage Collection Below Erasure Coding Redundancy Threshold
findings.resolution: Implemented NodeEpochFencingTracker::audit_gc_eligibility enforcing reachability across active generation, legal holds, retained historical versions, recovery checkpoints, in-flight transactions, and minimum surviving shards (> 12).

production_readiness_status: NOT ESTABLISHED (Academic distributed preservation protocol; physical bare-metal and multi-day soak tests not executed).
